# SC-03: A line with an unknown code stops on the exceptions list

## Steps
1. Send the 3 purchase orders with one altered code each to the orders mailbox.
2. Open the exceptions list and the order sheet copy.

## Expected result
Each altered line is on the exceptions list with the code and the customer, and not in the order sheet (3 cases).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: the client's September set, one product code altered in each copy (real data: client decision, operations manager, 2027-01-04); records: 3 order numbers from the set; count: 3; fields: product code.
